'''Vengo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] who served in the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He was stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around [[3643 BBY]].
